registered: 2026-10-15, before any CS/CSE scenario was run

reproduce.tolerance: 5e-7 for V2/M4 (exact), 5e-4 for the 5A models (table rounding)

CS: k = 3..7: real CK_k cut; anchors before anchor k-1 removed from fc; program steps (all step variants) with t_cv_end before anchor k-1 start and A4 rows of segments before anchor k-1's segment removed; the stress history (operation data) is kept, as at CK1 (full history known, no anchor pair)
CSE: as CS on the PC10 cut (operation data cut 10 days before CK_k)
metric: mean CS MAE = mean over CS and CSE of the scenario MAE at delta 0.4, main step, A4 2 Ah (delta cancels for k >= 2 in all anchor-based models)
